changes: Added prepared Run replay, versioned observation and independently comparable release evidence.
The dashboard checks runner readiness before listing module test cases.
Long options require full spelling and global options precede the command. Invalid options exit 2 before provisioning.
connect --watch --read-only uses GET-only Windows observation. --no-provision permits internal connector access and exits 6 if no usable venv is installed.
Prepared flash records and send results identify frozen BAT and payload hashes and target boards.
Run origins accept a project label and history can be filtered before pagination; explicitly scoped CLI lookups reject other labels.
Plugin exports provide a machine-readable CLI contract and support omitting agent instruction files.
Release evidence includes behavioral changes. A trusted checkout can verify a detached SSH signature using a separately distributed signer list.

Path-based test run delegates TC selection to the connector. On TC failure, test logs RUN_ID --failure-attempt ATTEMPT_ID reads the saved log tails and per-board kernel evidence without claiming analysis or rerunning the test.
The connector file picker reports pending and unavailable states and preserves typed input on cancellation or failure.
With Monitor connected, saving the Linux TC root refreshes the Windows Host catalog. Reconnection retries outstanding folder changes. Clearing the selection removes the old catalog.

monitor ensure reports the managed dashboard URL after checking the installed release, UI, API and worker. It does not issue browser credentials or start a connector watcher. --no-provision skips tool and dependency installation.

connect export includes an explicitly selected or matching managed Monitor port. --without-monitor keeps the profile connector-only. A fresh connector-only export still omits the optional dashboard forward.
